svg.title: Подъём на носки на одной ноге с гантелью — положение 1
svg.desc: Original ImageGen hollow contour, vector traced. Single-leg calf raise, side-front three-quarter view. One stance foot on level floor, other knee clearly bent with free foot held BEHIND and above the floor in both phases. One dumbbell hangs from hand on stance side, other hand lightly touches a simple upright post. START stance heel down, FINISH stance heel visibly high with ball of the SAME foot still touching floor. Keep posture and support fixed, do not add a second dumbbell. Subtle floor line to show heel gap. Expert biomechanics approval pending.
